text: Only 4 habits are free. I understand that the developer wants to make money, but increasing this limit to 7 (or something like that) would encourage more users to engage with the app and possibly buy the premium version. Four habits feels too few to develop a consistent routine, and the price is too high for buy pig in a poke. I’m referring to the lifetime price, as I prefer not to support subscription models, whether you're an indie developer or a big company like Adobe.
